ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of the formation and development process of karst landforms on the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau, containing multiple profile stages; in the cave profile, karst forms such as underground caves and funnels can be seen, and the symbol for “stalactites” is marked in the legend, indicating deposits hanging downward from the top of the cave. Reasoning: The question asks about the formation process of the “stalactites” in the figure. Stalactites form inside karst caves; after water droplets containing calcium carbonate drip or seep out from the cave roof, carbon dioxide escapes, calcium carbonate precipitates and gradually accumulates, so their formation process is running-water deposition.
